title: YEEZY BOOST 350
description: Released on August 22nd, 2015, the Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Pirate Black’ features a pirate black/dark gray Primeknit upper with branded suede patches on the medial sides, patterned dark grey rope laces, red accented heel tabs, and a black Boost outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 Infant
description: Released on August 24th, 2016, alongside the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Turtle Dove’ colorway, the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Pirate Black’ 2016 is an exact replica of the adult model in infant sizes from 5 to 10. The design features a pirate black/dark grey Primeknit upper with branded suede patches on the medial sides, patterned dark grey rope laces, red accented heel tabs, and a black Boost outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Mono Ice’ represents one of four monochromatic colorways that collectively introduce a refreshed take on the minimalist silhouette. In lieu of traditional Primeknit, the upper is constructed from monofilament mesh, rendered in an icy blue shade and accented with a tonal lateral side stripe. Additional details include an interior cage, webbing heel tab and molded eyelets. A full-length Boost midsole delivers responsive cushioning. This shoe released exclusively in in North America, Latin America and China.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Kids ‘Bone’ features a tan polyester upper, accented on the lateral side panel with oversized 700 branding in a reflective silver finish. The lightweight build is secured with no-tie bungee laces, while contrasting black overlays provide added durability. A matching black PU midsole houses full-length drop-in Boost cushioning, visible underfoot through cut-out detailing on the herringbone rubber outsole.
